Election Commissioner Dissent and Dismissal of Impeachment Motion

Two Election Commissioners had raised serious objections concerning Gyanesh Kumar. A report questions why an impeachment motion against him was dismissed. The Election Commission stated in a press release that all decisions were taken unanimously, raising questions about how the Election Commissioners' objections were set aside.
